newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring bids down, white up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring bids down, white up.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring wheat fell on Wednesday in line with the sharp drop in Minneapolis spring wheat futures, dealers said.
But soft white wheat values rose.
Farm sales in Minnesota, North Dakota and Montana were slow as farmers concentrated on spring wheat plantings, dealers said.

Spring wheat plantings in North Dakota look set to be delayed in the northeast and Red River Valley counties this year, but prospects elsewhere in the state appear favorable, a leading agronomist said.

"For the most part, fields in central and western North Dakota are definitely going to get a much earlier start (to plantings) than the last two years if this weather pattern continues," said Kent McKay of North Dakota State University. for higher prices, merchandisers said.
MGE May wheat tumbled 11 cents to end at $4.54-1/4 a bushel while the rest of the board was 10 to 12-1/2 cents down.
